# Cantus

<!-- cantus:start — generated by `cantus notes`; edit outside these markers -->
## Project map (Cantus)

This project is split into 12 blocks. Each block folder has its own notes (AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md), loaded when you work there. With the Cantus MCP server, start from `map`, then `block_context` for the block you work on.

- `cli` (interface): src/cli.ts, src/main.ts, src/index.ts — Command line entry point and the public package API.
- `src-analysis` (application): src/analysis — Reads the code with oxc: blocks, imports and call sites, contracts, API catalog, diagnostics, and findings against the map.
- `src-context` (application): src/context — Builds the briefing for working on one block: its API, the APIs it uses, its callers, open findings.
- `src-model` (domain): src/model — The map: blocks, dependencies, layer rules, and per-role agent settings.
- `src-outputs` (interface): src/outputs — Interactive HTML map and the per-block Claude Code subagents.
- `src-map` (application): src/map — Keeps the map in step with the code: updates it, writes per-block notes (AGENTS.md), scaffolds a new project from a design.
- `src-mcp` (interface): src/mcp — Exposes the map, block briefings, API search and callers to coding CLIs over MCP.
- `src-hooks` (interface): src/hooks — Claude Code hooks: a short map at session start, block and callers context before an edit, broken-API warnings after it; reads a compact project index.
- `src-serve` (interface): src/serve — Serves the live map on localhost: updates as the code changes, scopes of selected blocks, saving groups.
- `src-run` (application): src/run — Runs coding tasks started from the map: a Claude Code session (Agent SDK) briefed on a block or group, with approvals, optional git worktree, diff, merge or discard.
- `scripts` (unassigned): scripts, plugin/scripts — Helper scripts for trying Cantus on a real project: collect a report of every step, measure the MCP answers, and the phase 1 loop that tests it with a real Claude Code.
- `src-state` (application): src/state — The analyzed project kept in memory for long-running processes (re-analyzed only when files change), and the compact index the hooks read.
<!-- cantus:end -->
